title: When Scaling Fails: Mitigating Audio Perception Decay of LALMs via Multi-Step Perception-Aware Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2603.02266v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Test-Time Scaling has shown notable efficacy in addressing complex problems through scaling inference compute. However, within Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs), an unintuitive phenomenon exists: post-training models for structured reasoning trajectories results in marginal or even negative gains compared to post-training for direct answering. To investigate it, we introduce CAFE, an evaluation framework designed to precisely quantify audio reasoning errors. Evaluation results reveal LALMs struggle with perception during reasoning and encounter a critical bottleneck: reasoning performance suffers from audio perception decay as reasoning length extends. To address it, we propose MPAR$^2$, a paradigm that encourages dynamic perceptual reasoning and decomposes complex questions into perception-rich sub-problems. translated_title: 当扩展失效时：通过多步感知推理缓解大型音频-语言模型的音频感知衰退
translated_abstract: 测试时扩展通过增加推理计算量，在解决复杂问题方面已展现出显著效果。然而，在大型音频-语言模型中存在一种反直觉的现象：与针对直接回答进行后训练相比，针对结构化推理轨迹进行后训练只能带来微小的甚至负面的收益。为了研究这一现象，我们引入了CAFE，一个旨在精确量化音频推理错误的评估框架。评估结果揭示，LALMs在推理过程中难以进行感知，并遭遇一个关键瓶颈：随着推理长度的延长，推理性能会因音频感知衰退而受损。为解决这一问题，我们提出了MPAR²，这是一种鼓励动态感知推理、并将复杂问题分解为富含感知信息的子问题的范式。借助强化学习，MPAR²将CAFE上的感知性能从31.74%提升至63.51%，并有效……
tldr: 该研究揭示了大型音频-语言模型存在“音频感知衰退”瓶颈——推理链越长感知越差，并提出基于强化学习的多步感知推理范式MPAR²，将CAFE基准上的感知性能从31.74%大幅提升至63.51%。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies a critical "audio perception decay" bottleneck in Large Audio-Language Models—where perception degrades as reasoning lengthens—and proposes MPAR², a reinforcement learning-based multi-step perception-aware reasoning paradigm that boosts perception performance on CAFE from 31.74% to 63.51%.
